kb_knowledge.short_description: SAP application server restart procedure and health checks
kb_knowledge.text:
SAP Application Server Restart Procedure

Use this procedure when the SAP application server needs to be restarted due to performance issues, memory leaks, or unresponsive services.

Pre-Restart Checklist

  • Notify affected users via the ServiceNow broadcast message
  • Verify no critical batch jobs are currently running (transaction SM37)
  • Check current active user sessions (transaction SM04)

Restart Steps

  1. Log into the SAP application server via SSH
  2. Stop the SAP instance: sapcontrol -nr 00 -function Stop
  3. Wait for confirmation that all work processes are stopped
  4. Start the SAP instance: sapcontrol -nr 00 -function Start
  5. Monitor startup logs: sapcontrol -nr 00 -function GetProcessList
  6. Verify all services show GREEN status

Post-Restart Validation

  • Check SAP dispatcher is accepting connections on port 3200
  • Verify ICM service is running (transaction SMICM)
  • Test login from a client workstation
  • Confirm batch job scheduler is active (transaction SM36)
